message.content:
The illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters across the top. Below this, smaller text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". The main headline in large, gold-toned capital letters is "PARADOKS AMIR HAMZAH". Smaller text beneath describes a person's life and death. The date "14-20 AGUSTUS 2017" and a barcode are in the bottom right.

The scene features several men with dark hair and tan skin in a wooden structure. In the foreground, a seated man with short dark hair and closed eyes writes on a white piece of paper with a dark utensil. He wears a yellow-toned cloth wrapped around his waist. To his right, a hand enters from the edge of the frame, pointing a brown and black rifle directly at him. Surrounding these figures are several standing men with similar physical features, wearing light-colored trousers. They have neutral or downcast facial expressions and are barefoot on a floor made of wooden planks. The background consists of a simple wooden ceiling and walls. All elements are rendered in a flat, comic-book style with thick outlines.
